messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] plot.rf function
parts:
Due to a change in R, we had to change the names of a bunch of functions. Instead of plot.rf(), you need to use plotRF().
See https://rqtl.org/book/#errata

qtlcharts is a separate package. To install it, use install.packages("qtlcharts")
For further information about R/qtlcharts, see https://kbroman.org/qtlcharts

karl
